harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 both immediately and persistently across reboot: added /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false), rebuilt the initramfs with dracut --force so the rule applies at early boot, verified modprobe now refuses to load the module, then performed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol (baseline boot_id/health capture, systemctl reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified post-reboot that usb-storage remains blocked and unloaded with the system fully running).
actions_performed: Checked baseline: usb-storage not loaded, kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 (cmd-7c54c463e4c245fe)
Created /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf with blacklist and install /bin/false directives (cmd-4c4b4ee53bd24298)
Confirmed the rule was initially absent from the initramfs (cmd-5195efcf90514276)
Rebuilt initramfs via dracut --force to embed the blacklist for early boot (cmd-2a1449e008664d6f)
Confirmed the blacklist config is now present inside the rebuilt initramfs (cmd-d24f9b3266ea4fd0)
Verified modprobe usb-storage fails immediately and module stays unloaded (cmd-191fd5957e2b401e)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and healthy system state (cmd-3b1e4caa232548d8)
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect (cmd-a4d222d3f5234ac5)
Polled node1 until exec access returned (cmd-e0ebfa64ea8f43a4, cmd-6a2b4e0d097748d8, cmd-79672831a7a74800)
Confirmed changed boot_id proving actual restart (cmd-79672831a7a74800)
Verified post-reboot that usb-storage remains unloaded, modprobe is still blocked, and system is fully running (cmd-dc55fd7e3b1b4806)

evidence.requirement: usb-storage module blacklisted from loading now
evidence.summary: Created modprobe.d blacklist+install /bin/false rule; modprobe usb-storage then failed with exit 1 and module absent from lsmod.

evidence.requirement: usb-storage module blocked from loading after reboot (persistence)
evidence.summary: Rule was missing from initramfs, rebuilt with dracut --force, confirmed rule embedded in initramfs, and after actual reboot modprobe usb-storage still fails and module stays unloaded.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory single-node restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured pre-reboot boot_id (98aa35f5...) and healthy state; issued systemctl reboot with ack before disconnect; polled through connection drops until exec returned; observed changed boot_id (ad8aaaf5...) proving restart; confirmed post-reboot system running and usb-storage block still enforced.
